email.ignored: Identity: the login writes it, and the file name is derived from it.

headers.secret: Headers sent upstream with the login's requests, which can carry a credential.

id_token.ignored: A token: the login writes it and CPA refreshes it.

plan_type.ignored: Identity: the plan the login reports, part of a Codex file name.

proxy_url.secret: The login's outbound proxy URL, which can carry a user and password.

type.ignored: Identity: the provider the login belongs to, written by the login.

access.api-keys[].secret: A client key the proxy accepts; it grants use of every login behind the proxy.

api-keys.*[].headers.<name>.secret: An upstream request header, which can carry a credential (an Authorization value): it reaches the store unless given as a file or helper.

api-keys.*[].keys[].api-key.secret: An upstream credential: it reaches the store unless given as a file or helper.

api-keys.*[].keys[].headers.<name>.secret: An upstream request header, which can carry a credential (an Authorization value): it reaches the store unless given as a file or helper.

api-keys.*[].keys[].proxy-url.secret: A proxy URL, which can carry a user and password (socks5://user:pass@host:port): it reaches the store unless given as a file or helper.

api-keys.*[].proxy-url.secret: A proxy URL, which can carry a user and password (socks5://user:pass@host:port): it reaches the store unless given as a file or helper.

management.secret-key.secret: The management API key; CPA hashes a plaintext value into its own config at start.

requests.proxy-url.secret: A proxy URL, which can carry a user and password (socks5://user:pass@host:port): it reaches the store unless given as a file or helper.

server.github-token.secret: A GitHub token CPA sends with its release and asset downloads.
